overview_description.description: Bazaara is a peer-to-peer resale marketplace that enables users to exchange fashion items, accessories, and lifestyle products through a community-driven platform. It focuses on sustainable commerce by extending product lifecycles and promoting circular fashion. The platform connects individuals who want to offload unused items with others seeking affordable, pre-owned alternatives, while supporting a simple and convenient online transaction experience.
